Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the modifier runs. A disabled modifier leaves the pose it's given unchanged.

Fields.Name: Target (World Space)
Fields.Description: Where the bone is held, in world space. Usually set by the game.

Fields.Name: Target Bone
Fields.Description: The bone that's held in place.

Fields.Name: New Target Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the bone follows a new target (0 to 1 per frame).

Fields.Name: On Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the fix blends in (0 to 1 per frame).

Fields.Name: Off Gain
Fields.Description: How fast the fix blends out (0 to 1 per frame).

Fields.Name: Is OK
Fields.Description: Whether the target is valid, so the fix applies. Usually set by the game.
